description: Hot-Cold Map Provides Blueprint for Protecting Ecosystems is a case study listed in U.S. Climate Resilience Toolkit, a national climate-adaptation toolkit, published or maintained by North Quabbin Regional Landscape Partnership; Mount Grace Land Conservation Trust; Open Space Institute. A regional conservation partnership in Massachusetts needed to update their approach to evaluating land acquisitions. Adding the complexity of climate change to their map helped resolve their vision. Coverage: Massachusetts (2015). The toolkit gives Massachusetts as the location, 2015 as the year. The listed link gives the documented application. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the toolkit page (no licence or terms statement seen). Caveats: this record was written from the toolkit page, which was read; the cited source documents and the outcomes reported were not checked, and no model or dataset used was verified. It can support comparison with similar adaptation projects and planning precedents. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-us-climate-resilience-toolkit-catalogue.
